name: Architect
description: At game end, worth 1 point for each of your leftover resin and pebbles, up to 6 points total.

name: Bard
description: Discard up to 5 cards from your hand, to gain 1 point token for each card.

name: Barge Toad
description: When played and during Production, gain 2 twigs for each Farm in your city.

name: Chip Sweep
description: When played and during Production, activate any 1 green Production card in your city.

name: Doctor
description: When played and during Production, you may pay up to 3 berries to gain 1 point token for each berry.

name: Fool
description: The Fool is played into an empty spot in an opponent’s city. The Fool may be played into an opponent’s city if that opponent has already finished the game. If you play the Fool, discard the Fool and remove any 1 card from his city.

name: Historian
description: Draw 1 card after you play a Critter or Construction.

name: Husband
description: Shares a space with a Wife, so combined they only take up 1 space in your city. If you have a Farm in your city and this Husband is paired with a Wife, this card gives you 1 of any resource when played and during Production. May only share a space with 1 Wife.

name: Innkeeper
description: When you play a Critter, you may discard this Innkeeper from your city to decrease the cost of the played Critter by 3 berries. You do not gain the 3 berries. This card cannot be combined with other card-playing abilities.

name: Judge
description: When playing a Critter or Construction, you may replace 1 of any resource from the listed cost with 1 of any other resource you have.

name: King
description: At game end, worth 1 point for each basic Event, and 2 points for each special Event you have achieved.

name: Miner Mole
description: When played and during Production, you may copy any 1 green Production card in any opponent’s city.

name: Monk
description: When played and during Production, you may give up to 2 berries to an opponent to gain 2 point tokens for each berry you give. Also unlocks the 2nd Monastery room.

name: Peddler
description: When played and during Production, you may trade up to 2 of your resources for 2 of any other resource. Trade with the general supply, not other players.

name: Postal Pigeon
description: When played, reveal 2 cards from the deck. You may immediately play 1 of these worth up to 3 points, for free. Discard the other.

name: Undertaker
description: When played, discard 3 of the Meadow cards, replenish those 3 cards, then draw 1 card from the Meadow. Also unlocks the 2nd Cemetery plot.

name: Queen
description: When you place a worker here, you may play any card from your hand or the Meadow cards worth up to 3 points for free. This refers to the base points of the card, not bonus points.

name: Ranger
description: When played, move any 1 of your deployed workers to a new location, following the normal worker placement rules. Also unlocks the 2nd Dungeon cell. You may not place the Ranger in the second cell of the Dungeon.

name: Shepherd
description: When played, gain 3 berries. Also gain 1 point token for each point token on your Chapel.

name: Shopkeeper
description: Gain 1 berry after you play a Critter into your city. Do not gain a berry for playing this Shopkeeper.

name: Teacher
description: When played and during Production, draw 2 cards. Keep 1 of them and give the other to any opponent that has room in their hand.

name: Wanderer
description: When played, draw 3 cards. The Wanderer does not take up 1 of the 15 spots in your city.

name: Wife
description: Shares a space with a Husband, so combined they only take up 1 space in your city. At game end, worth 3 points if paired with a Husband. May only share space with 1 Husband.

name: Woodcarver
description: When played and during Production, you may pay up to 3 twigs to gain 1 point token for each.

name: Castle
description: At game end, worth 1 point for each Common Construction in your city.

name: Cemetery
description: When you place a worker here, reveal 4 cards from the draw pile or discard pile and play 1 of them for free. Discard the others. Your worker must stay here permanently. Cemetery may only have up to 2 workers on it, but the second spot must be unlocked by having an Undertaker in your city.

name: Chapel
description: When you place a worker here, place 1 point token on the Chapel from the supply. Draw 2 cards for every 1 point token on the Chapel.

name: Clocktower
description: When you play the Clock Tower, place 3 point tokens on it from the supply. Before you bring back your workers during a Prepare for Season action, you may return 1 point token from the Clock Tower to the supply and activate one of the Basic or Forest locations where you have a worker deployed. Any points left on the Clock Tower at game’s end count towards your point total.

name: Courthouse
description: Gain 1 twig, 1 resin, or 1 pebble every time you play a Construction into your city. You do not gain resources for playing this Courthouse.

name: Crane
description: When you play a Construction, you may discard this Crane from your city to decrease the cost of the played Construction by 3 of any combination of resources. You do not gain the 3 resources. This card cannot be combined with other card-playing abilities.

name: Dungeon
description: When you are playing a Construction or a Critter, you may place a Critter from your city beneath this Dungeon to decrease the cost of the played card by 3 of any combination of resources. You do not gain the 3 resources. The Critter in your Dungeon is no longer considered part of your city and is not worth any points. Dungeon can only have up to 2 prisoners, but the second cell must be unlocked by having a Ranger in your city.

name: Ever Tree
description: At game end, worth 1 point for each purple Prosperity card in your city, including this Ever Tree. Ever Tree can grant 1 of any Critter for free.

name: Fair Grounds
description: When played and during Production, draw 2 cards.

name: Farm
description: When played and during Production, gain 1 berry.

name: General Store
description: When played and during Production, gain 1 berry or gain 2 berries if you have at least one Farm in your city, not 2 berries per Farm.

name: Inn
description: When you place a worker here, play a Critter or Construction from the Meadow for 3 fewer resources of your choice. You do not gain the 3 resources. You gain 1 point token if an opponent visits your Inn.

name: Lookout
description: When you place a worker here, copy any 1 Basic or Forest location, even if it is occupied by 1 of your workers.

name: Mine
description: When played and during Production, gain 1 pebble.

name: Monastery
description: When you place a worker here, give 2 of any resources to an opponent and then gain 4 points. The worker stays here permanently. Monastery can only have up to 2 workers on it, but the second spot must be unlocked by having a Monk in your city.

name: Palace
description: At game end, worth 1 point for each Unique Construction in your city, including this Palace.

name: Post Office
description: When you place a worker here, give an opponent 2 cards from your hand and then discard any amount of cards from your hand that you want. You must be able to give the 2 cards in order to place a worker here. Then draw cards from the deck up to your hand limit. You gain 1 point token if an opponent visits your Post Office.

name: Resin Refinery
description: When played and during Production, gain 1 resin.

name: Ruins
description: When played, discard a Construction from your city and place this card in that spot, then receive back that Construction’s listed cost in resources. Also draw 2 cards. If you remove a card with point tokens on it, you lose those point tokens. If you remove a card with a worker deployed onto it that is not there permanently, place that worker on the Ruins.

name: School
description: At game end, worth 1 point for each Common Critter in your city.

name: Storehouse
description: When played and during Production, take from the supply and place either 3 twigs, 2 resin, 1 pebble, or 2 berries on this card. Also works as a location to place a worker and take all of the resources on the card.

name: Theater
description: At game end is worth 1 point for each Unique Critter in your city.

name: Twig Barge
description: When played and during Production, gain 2 twigs.

name: University
description: When you place a worker here, discard 1 Construction or Critter from your city and receive back the listed cost of resources of the discarded card, plus gain 1 of any resource and gain 1 point. If you discard a card with point tokens on it, you lose those point tokens.
